altimate.authFlow: API key from Settings -> API key in Altimate instance plus instance name derived from {instance}.app.myaltimate.com (here vinh); VSCode extension sends both to https://api.myaltimate.com backend for SaaS features
altimate.endpointType: data-engineering agents only (generate dbt docs, column lineage, query explanation, SQL optimization); no public OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions or general text-generation endpoint for ALTIMATE_API_KEY; Altimate Code consumes external LLMs (BYOK) and managed LLM Gateway via IDE, not a probeable LLM source

corti.authFlow: OAuth2 client_credentials: POST https://auth.{environment}.corti.app/realms/{tenant}/protocol/openid-connect/token with client_id, client_secret, grant_type=client_credentials, scope=openid; Bearer token (project API key / user API key / OAuth access token) for Models API
corti.baseUrl: https://ai.us.corti.app/v1 (env us, tenant base); clinical API https://api.us.corti.app/v2
corti.endpointType: OpenAI-compatible: POST /v1/chat/completions, POST /v1/completions, POST /v1/responses; list via GET /v1/models
